title: WorkspaceGroupUpdate
description: Request body for updating an existing workspace group.

name.description: Updated name for the workspace group.

firewallRanges.description: Updated list of CIDR IP ranges permitted to connect to workspaces.

allowAllTraffic.description: When true, allows all inbound traffic regardless of firewall range configuration.

expiresAt.description: Updated expiration timestamp after which the workspace group is automatically terminated.
